title: Google says Android's AirDrop-like Quick Share will now let some devices exchange files and contact info when tapped together, starting with Pixel 6 and newer (Jess Weatherbed/The Verge)
summary: Jess Weatherbed / The Verge: Google says Android's AirDrop-like Quick Share will now let some devices exchange files and contact info when tapped together, starting with Pixel 6 and newer — The Quick Share update makes it easier to share contact info and files between Pixel devices, and soon, Samsung phones.
